review_candidates.title: Collaboration Solution Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Collaboration Solutions Engineer is responsible for planning and executing solutions that transition users, data, collaboration services, and configurations while maintaining business continuity, security, compliance, and a positive employee experience. This role will partner with business leaders and stakeholders, to translate transaction requirements into practical migration strategies and execution plans across the Microsoft product stack. eligibility_evidence: This role is not eligible for VISA sponsorship.
Experience with hybrid identity, Active Directory, device migration, external collaboration, domain cutovers, and enterprise change management.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This role will partner with business leaders and stakeholders, to translate transaction requirements into practical migration strategies and execution plans across the Microsoft product stack. What You Will Do Lead end-to-end Microsoft 365 discovery and technical due diligence conversations, analyzing users, groups, mailboxes, Teams, SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, applications, compliance and retention requirements, licensing, and data volumes to inform migration strategy, risk assessment, and solution design. Plan identity matching, target-account provisioning, UPN and SMTP changes, domain transfer activities, mail flow, calendar free/busy, Teams federation, and other coexistence requirements. Who You Are (Basic Qualifications) Experience administering, supporting, or migrating Microsoft 365 services. What Will Put You Ahead Hands-on experience with Quest On Demand Migration, Ques
